sources.name: NBA official injury reports
sources.scope: Daily 5 PM Eastern snapshot, collected after a 30-minute publication allowance. This is not the latest intraday report. Unsubmitted team reports are identified separately.
sources.policy_note: Use the public report for factual research summaries only. No PDF, report prose, logos or deep links are republished. Check robots on every run.

sources.name: SCACCHoops conference listings
sources.scope: Men's conference pages provided by SCACCHoops; not a complete NCAA injury registry. The source supplies no report dates, and listings may be old.
sources.policy_note: Existing project source; publish normalized facts only, never its details text. Check robots and pause between conference requests.

sources.name: WNBA official injury reports
sources.scope: Daily 5 PM Eastern report PDF during the configured May–October collection window. WNBA team mapping is separate from the NBA. Not the latest intraday report.
sources.policy_note: Read only the public report PDF host, whose robots policy permits this path; do not crawl the restricted WNBA index. Publish normalized facts, not report text.

sources.name: ACC women's availability reports
sources.scope: ACC conference games only. Availability reports do not identify the medical reason for an absence.
sources.reason: The embedded provider returns HTML instead of a readable robots policy. Confirm permitted automated access and validate its feed before enabling.
